title: El Danzón de Córdoba, MAJESTIC STORIES
comment: danzon-cordoba (MAJESTIC): plaza de armas de Córdoba, Veracruz, junto al kiosco, temprano por la tarde, sin gente. Caras comunes, no famosas; los tres se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.FELICIANO_CARRANZA: Mexican man, powerful widowed hacienda owner, 63 years old, fair tanned skin, silver hair neatly combed back, a short silver beard, kind but proud grey-brown eyes, a cream linen suit jacket over a white guayabera, a white panama hat in his hand, a gold wedding band, his hands otherwise empty.
chars.ESPERANZA_LARA: Mexican woman, danzon teacher in the town square, 58 years old, warm brown skin, black hair with a white streak in an elegant low bun with a red flower, expressive dark eyes, red lipstick, a flowing white dress with red embroidered details at the neckline, a red fan in her hand, her hands otherwise empty.
chars.HERMELINDA_CARRANZA: Mexican woman, the hacienda owner's older sister, 67 years old, fair skin, short white hair in tight curls, sharp blue-grey eyes behind thin gold glasses, a dark-navy long-sleeve dress with a white collar, a pearl necklace, a small black handbag on her arm, her hands empty.

locs.LOC_PLAZACORDOBA: Main square of Cordoba, Veracruz, in the early warm afternoon: a white wrought-iron bandstand kiosk, tall laurel trees, colonial arcades with arches, black and white checkered tile floor near the kiosk, iron benches, tropical plants, soft golden light, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
